findings.title: Accept the actual bag committed-receipt schema explicitly
findings.finding: successfulPredecessor unconditionally dereferences commit.result.status and commit.result.committed for both predecessors. The frozen shopping-bag commit source emits top-level status, committed, plan_sha256, prepared_sha256, state and target_manifest with no result object. Root confirmed that its planned actual bag receipt uses this top-level shape. Selecting that genuine receipt therefore throws before opening the preparation session, even after successful bag persistence.
findings.required_change: Create a fresh source revision with explicit predecessor-specific receipt validation: retain the actual accepted fourth10 schema and validate the bag top-level committed fields. Bind the actual persisted schema when it exists. Do not manufacture a wrapper or alter a genuine receipt to satisfy r02.

findings.title: Require an identified independent source and binding reviewer
findings.finding: The review gate verifies status, two hashes and preparation_execution_accepted but never checks reviewer identity. A review with no reviewer, an empty reviewer, or the preparation author's own identity satisfies this gate. That fails the documented independent source-and-binding acceptance contract and repeats a guard class already treated as material in earlier delivery work.
findings.required_change: Require a nonempty reviewer identity distinct from the preparation author, and bind the applicable author/reviewer roles explicitly. Apply the repository's dispatcher separation rule if required by the final root contract. Include negative guard evidence for missing, empty and author-self reviewer values before actual preparation.
findings.method: Static control-flow inspection only; no forged review was written and no guard code was executed.

findings.title: Bind predecessor journals and the complete bag installed-target set to their commits
findings.finding: The gate accepts any separately pinned journal whose status is committed; it does not require that journal's hash, prepared identity or plan identity to match the selected commit. Nonempty caller-authored success_assertions can check only a generic status. The installed_targets loop later requires just a nonempty list containing five named files and verifies those selected pins; it does not compare the list with the complete authoritative bag target_manifest. A partial installed list or unrelated committed journal can therefore satisfy the executable gate despite the documented complete predecessor contract.
findings.required_change: In the fresh predecessor-specific validator, require the committed-state hash named by each receipt, matching prepared/plan identity, and exact equality of bag installed targets with the receipt's complete target_manifest including byte lengths and afterimage hashes. Allow a durable journal-copy path only through an explicit exact-content binding. Keep caller success_assertions as additional checks, not substitutes for these mandatory relationships.
findings.method: Static control-flow and receipt-contract inspection only. Actual binding remains unselected.
